subject: deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash, Hugging Face revision 2cba9e42aa026125f3ed06c6d98c1db82f7ca027, updated 2026-10-01
central_claim: DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash is a publishable AI engineering topic because public primary sources support an E2/R2 bounded claim: DeepSeek released an open-weight multimodal MoE model whose Causal Encoder-Decoder architecture, sparse-attention and compressed KV-cache design target long agent inputs, with public model weights, config, inference code, prompt encoding code and DeepSWE reproduction instructions. The article does not claim independent reproduction of DeepSeek's benchmark scores or superiority over competing frontier models.

selection.reason: The topic affects teams deciding whether to evaluate open-weight long-context multimodal agent models. It is novel because the public materials describe a Causal Encoder-Decoder and compressed KV-cache design rather than only a larger context window. It is verifiable through the Hugging Face model card, API metadata, raw config, public files, evaluation README and DeepSeek's deepseek-recipe GitHub repository. Decision utility is high because engineers can inspect architecture, prompt protocol, reproducibility requirements and serving constraints before planning evaluations. Korean-reader relevance is moderate because Korean product and platform teams face the same long-context agent cost and self-hosting questions, although the model is not Korea-specific.

claims.claim: DeepSeek released DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash as a public, ungated, MIT-tagged Hugging Face model with model card, technical report, config, safetensors, inference code, prompt encoding code, evaluation instructions and a companion protocol-conversion repository; the public material supports an E2/R2 article about its long-context KV-cache design and self-hosting evaluation surface, but not an independent performance-ranking claim.

claim_source_ledger.claim: The model card says DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash is a multimodal MoE model with 552B backbone parameters, 1M-token context support, a 20-layer causal encoder plus 20-layer decoder Causal Encoder-Decoder architecture, and decoder global KV cache projected from final encoder hidden states.
claim_source_ledger.method: Read the model card introduction and architecture description.
limitations: Architecture description is from the model developer.
The article does not independently inspect the full model implementation against the report.

claim_source_ledger.claim: The model card attributes reduced cache footprint to SWA Bounded Replay, Compressed Sparse Attention 2 and FP4 main KV caching, and states the global KV cache footprint is 890 bytes per token, roughly one quarter of DeepSeek-V4-Flash.
claim_source_ledger.version: DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash model card, introduction section, accessed 2026-10-04
claim_source_ledger.method: Read the architecture and KV-cache description in the model card.
